title: Shifted Horadam Collocation Method for Solution of Nonlinear Fourth-Order Boundary Value Problem in Ordinary Differential Equation
summary: In this paper, numerical solutions of a class of nonlinear ordinary differential equations are obtained using a collocation method based on the shifted Horadam polynomials. The proposed problem, which is of the fourth-order, satisfies a class of two-point boundary conditions. We first discuss definitions and basic properties of the Horadam polynomials before presenting new and useful differentiation formulae for them.
